invitations_email_lower.name: invitations_email_lower
invitations_email_lower.value: "invitations"."email" = lower("invitations"."email") AND char_length("invitations"."email") between 3 and 254 AND "invitations"."email" like '%_@_%'

invitations_accepted_fields.name: invitations_accepted_fields
invitations_accepted_fields.value: ("invitations"."status" = 'accepted') = ("invitations"."accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

stock_movements_sign.name: stock_movements_sign
stock_movements_sign.value:
"stock_movements"."quantity" <> 0 AND (
        ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('PURCHASE_IN','SALE_RETURN_IN','ADJUSTMENT_IN','TRANSFER_IN','OPENING_STOCK') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" > 0)
        OR ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('SALE_OUT','PURCHASE_RETURN_OUT','ADJUSTMENT_OUT','TRANSFER_OUT') AND "stock_movements"."quantity" < 0)
        OR "stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'VOID_REVERSAL')

stock_movements_reason.name: stock_movements_reason
stock_movements_reason.value:
("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('ADJUSTMENT_IN','ADJUSTMENT_OUT')) = ("stock_movements"."reason_code" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("stock_movements"."reason_code" IS NULL OR "stock_movements"."reason_code" in ('damaged','lost','found','count_correction','expired','other'))

customers_gstin_matches_state.name: customers_gstin_matches_state
customers_gstin_matches_state.value: "customers"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("customers"."state_code" IS NOT NULL AND left("customers"."gstin", 2) = "customers"."state_code")

suppliers_gstin_matches_state.name: suppliers_gstin_matches_state
suppliers_gstin_matches_state.value: "suppliers"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("suppliers"."state_code" IS NOT NULL AND left("suppliers"."gstin", 2) = "suppliers"."state_code")

purchases_void_fields.name: purchases_void_fields
purchases_void_fields.value: ("purchases"."status" = 'voided') = ("purchases"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "purchases"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "purchases"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL)

credit_notes_exchange.name: credit_notes_exchange
credit_notes_exchange.value: "credit_notes"."exchange_paise" >= 0 AND "credit_notes"."exchange_paise" <= "credit_notes"."refund_paise" AND ("credit_notes"."exchange_paise" = 0 OR "credit_notes"."exchange_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("credit_notes"."refund_method" <> 'exchange' OR ("credit_notes"."exchange_invoice_id" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_notes"."exchange_paise" = "credit_notes"."refund_paise"))

invoice_items_money.name: invoice_items_money
invoice_items_money.value: "invoice_items"."unit_price_paise" >= 0 AND "invoice_items"."line_discount_paise" >= 0 AND "invoice_items"."bill_discount_paise" >= 0 AND "invoice_items"."taxable_paise" >= 0 AND "invoice_items"."cgst_paise" = "invoice_items"."sgst_paise" AND "invoice_items"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "invoice_items"."cgst_paise" >= 0

invoices_money_non_negative.name: invoices_money_non_negative
invoices_money_non_negative.value: "invoices"."gross_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."discount_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."taxable_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."cgst_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."igst_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."paid_paise" >= 0 AND "invoices"."credit_paise" >= 0

invoices_void_fields.name: invoices_void_fields
invoices_void_fields.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'voided') = ("invoices"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_text_lengths.name: invoices_text_lengths
invoices_text_lengths.value: char_length("invoices"."seller_name") <= 200 AND char_length("invoices"."seller_address") <= 700 AND char_length("invoices"."buyer_name") <= 200 AND char_length("invoices"."buyer_address") <= 500 AND char_length("invoices"."void_reason") <= 500

tax_rates_price_range.name: tax_rates_price_range
tax_rates_price_range.value: ("tax_rates"."price_min_paise" IS NULL OR "tax_rates"."price_min_paise" >= 0) AND ("tax_rates"."price_max_paise" IS NULL OR "tax_rates"."price_max_paise" > coalesce("tax_rates"."price_min_paise", 0))

settings_gstin_matches_registration.name: settings_gstin_matches_registration
settings_gstin_matches_registration.value: ("settings"."gstin" IS NOT NULL) = ("settings"."gst_registration" IS NOT NULL AND "settings"."gst_registration" <> 'unregistered')

settings_gstin_matches_state.name: settings_gstin_matches_state
settings_gstin_matches_state.value: "settings"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("settings"."state_code" IS NOT NULL AND left("settings"."gstin", 2) = "settings"."state_code")
